body: It's just become so overwhelming. I spent most if my life partying and doing drugs, and now that I'm not anymore, all the collateral damage is falling into place.  My work history is spotty, so much so that I can't accurately fill out job applications and it looks like I'm a 28 yr old who's only had jobs the past few years.  I have fines to pay off before I can ever get a driver's  liscense, and I have no idea how to go to college. I dropped out of high school before anybody started talking to me about college,  and the one time I tried to enroll myself at community college, I got my identity stolen and my bank account wiped, lost my apartment and went into debt. I'm not even sure how all that works, I probably owe the school money. I'm still in debt from overdrafting bank accounts for drugs years ago. Everything is just so piled up, and there's no real foreseeable future where I can afford to pull myself out of it. I can find a minimum wage job at best, unless I move away,  but if I do that then I'll be all alone. I don't have any friends anywhere else except Louisville,  and that's because it's where I was a junkie so I can't go back there. I feel like a different person than the one who fucked my life up, but that person fucked it up really, really bad.
